Title: The Everyday Habit Secretly Fueling Your Adult Acne

Description:
Post-workout protein shake, a milky latte, a bag of chips at your desk - sounds like a normal day, but it's oddly common in people with jawline and cheek acne. Nearly half of American women in their 20s deal with it. Whey protein shakes have been linked to breakouts in bodybuilders within weeks of starting them, skim milk carries a stronger acne link than whole milk, and high-glycemic snacks like potato chips spike the same insulin pathway.

Watch to find out why these three habits raise IGF-1 and oil production, and the easy swaps that don't mean giving up protein, dairy, or snacks for good.
